lines.text: David calls on the LORD to come quickly and asks that his prayer be set before Him like incense.
David asks the LORD to set a guard over his mouth and keep his heart from evil.
David says a Philistine giant should strike him, and calls that rebuke an act of loving devotion.
David says the people will listen to his pleasant words, and bones are scattered like a potter smashing a jar.
David fixes his eyes on God, seeks refuge in Him, and asks that the wicked fall into their nets.
